purpose: Route-level axe debt for the DS reference lab under the Modern engine: two real BitHire-vertical tenants (a static FlatTheme ground and a published-document ground compiled to an SSR-embedded artifact) across all 25 lab scenes, which between them cover all 24 primitives/inputs families. It records findings at the blocking impact named in "impacts" and nothing above it. Family-level axe debt is NOT here: it belongs to the per-family AXE_DEBT pins owned by WO-EVI-02, and a route-level finding whose node is already pinned there is recorded as routed, never re-litigated (L4).
owner: WO-INV-03 while it is open; thereafter the DS a11y CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml, the a11y specs step).
provenance: db759703a 2026-09-22 — schema and laws established by WO-INV-03 Lot C. The DT's first slot ran the batch read-only (AXE_NO_WRITE=1): 24 scenes settled, charts timed out, and the four other parameterized scenes had been scanned over a 404 — the case axis below is the repair (d7a878c71). SEEDED 2026-09-22: entries were adjudicated as empty and accepted by the DT's complete route batch of 2026-09-22 (run report generatedAt 2026-09-22T21:49:04.104Z, coverage complete 50/50 cells, findingCount 0). That run measured every declared scene x ground cell with none failed, timed out or skipped, found nothing at the recorded impact, and passed L1, so no finding at the blocking impact either; the run report is written only when all of that holds. The report lives at packages/core/artifacts/quality/audits/accessibility/runs/axe/index.json, which is gitignored run output, so this line is its durable record. Command: pnpm --filter @rottay/showroom run build, then DS_AXE_ROUTE_BATCH=1 pnpm --filter @rottay/showroom exec playwright test a11y/axe.spec.ts --config playwright.visual.config.ts
retire: The ledger's old deletion condition (the batch runs clean with no entries) was MET on 2026-09-22, and the file is deliberately kept: L5 makes a missing ledger fail the run, and an empty ledger is the strictest standing state, in which every new finding at the recorded impact fails the batch until a human admits it with a disposition, an owner and a WO. The file retires only together with the route batch itself, when a successor batch owns this matrix. Entries retire individually as their owner repairs them, via AXE_UPDATE_BASELINE=1 on a complete run, which rewrites entries to the intersection of this ledger and the current findings and therefore only ever shrinks.
